fact: The closest exoplanet to Earth — a roughly Earth-mass world in the habitable zone of the nearest star.
bio: Proxima Centauri b orbits the Sun's nearest neighbour just 4.24 light-years away, circling its cool red dwarf every 11 days within the zone where liquid water could exist. Its proximity made it the headline target of the Breakthrough Starshot project, which imagines gram-scale light-sail probes reaching it within a human lifetime — though the star's violent flares are a serious hazard to any atmosphere or life.
